text:
alex: Heads up — CI on main is red after the merge, the typecheck + lint pre-commit chain failed. Looks like a proto/gen-stub mismatch.
ci-bot: [CI] job #2314 failed on 'typecheck-and-lint' — https://ci.redwood.example/build/2314
priya: link? can't open full logs from mobile.
alex: https://ci.redwood.example/build/2314/logs -> see mypy/pyright section. snippet: 
```
pyright: error: Module 'redwood.proto' has no attribute 'Foo'
mypy: error: Incompatible return value type (got 'None', expected 'str')
```
jonathan: that smells like generated protos out of date or a protobuf bump. did pre-commit run `make gen-protos` on that CI worker?
mina: i hit a similar failure locally earlier — running `pre-commit run --all-files` fixed black/isort but mypy still fails for me until i regen the protos.
rachel: quick repro command: `python -m tools.gen_protos && tox -e typecheck` — if gen-stubs are stale that should reproduce.
priya: can someone bisect? we need the offending commit range, in case it's a dep bump.
jonathan: i can bisect. but can we rerun the failing job first to rule out flake? @ci-bot can you rerun job 2314? :pray:
ci-bot: Rerun requested for job #2314 by jonathan. Queueing.
alex: thanks. if rerun passes we'll close; if still red jonathan, please `git bisect start HEAD HEAD~20` and narrow down.
jonathan: starting bisect now, will post updates (ETA ~30m).
mina: FYI there's a pyright config change in #4672 that tightened `reportOptionalCall` — could be related if generated signatures changed. adding note to bisect.
alex: good call, add it to the bisect checklist.
jonathan: quick update: rerun failed as well. bisect hit commit abc123 -> fail, next step picking mid commit.
alex: appreciate the fast triage :thumbsup: 
jonathan: narrowed to commit def456 (protobuf bump to 4.x). generated API surface changed; regenerating protos locally fixes the type errors. i'll open a PR to regenerate protos + pin protobuf to 3.x in CI while we roll forward.
alex: please also add a CI pre-commit hook that runs proto-gen or fails early. want to avoid this slipping.
jonathan: will include hook and a short test in the PR, tagging reviewers @priya @mina.
priya: will review once CI is green.
mina: thanks — lgtm on the plan, will help with the proto gen test.
alex: thanks everyone, marking this thread as in-progress.
